text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa laughed pleasantly. At the 
gamble of aiming high and betting her all. 
At the sensation of feeling alive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The former homeroom teacher begged the 
Trainer: "Please let that girl live her 
life to the fullest."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having heard the hopes entrusted to her, 
Nakayama Festa fired herself up at her 
mentor's words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From here, the earnest pursuit of the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe begins. To gauge 
their chances of victory, information is 
crucial. They decided to focus on 
gathering data during the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the GIII Keisei Hai. 
Just like the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
it features a steep hill. The 
make-or-break gamble begins here.
